judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are same-grain Grade Key Competence statements at the same canonical coordinate (P3, rank 2) under the merged 'P3 Mathematics' Grade node, so direction rests on statement content rather than rank. The first competence establishes fluent counting, reading, writing, comparing/ordering of whole numbers to 10000 and effective, rapid use of the four operations (+, -, x, ÷) with 4-digit numbers. The second requires locating a missing number within addition and subtraction sentences with 4-digit numbers and explaining the method, which presupposes reliable execution of those same 4-digit addition/subtraction computations and adds inverse/structural reasoning and justification. Proficiency in the first therefore substantively supports likely success in the second; the reverse dependency is not supported. Shared tokens ('numbers', '4', 'digits'), same page and shared Grade parent alone were treated as nomination signals only. Both endpoints carry upstream audit/merge context and truncated source evidence, so the operational overlap is read from the complete, untruncated statement descriptions available here.
